mira: Heads up — 7:20 ferry just canceled due to surge. If you were planning to take it, fyi. Anyone switching routes? :umbrella:
samir: Ugh, was on the 7:05 Caltrain — sat at Millbrae for ~20m. Thinking of hopping on the 9:10 bus instead. Anyone near SoMa want a quick carpool?
devon: I'm on the K bus — slow but still moving. Leaving the house 15m earlier. Could grab Mira if needed.
transitbot: [automated] BART status update: Minor delays between Embarcadero and Daly City due to signal issue. Expect ~+10m. https://status.bart.gov
jordan: umbrella roulette is alive today. Lost one in the cafeteria earlier :sob: :umbrella:
elaine: Quick desk-check — who's still planning to come into the office today? Reply with `office` or `remote` so I can update the desk map and know how many mugs to warm. :coffee:
samir: remote (staying put, avoiding ferry chaos)
mira: office but delayed — might be 30-40m late, can meet at Embarcadero if anyone's walking in from there
devon: office, leaving now. Can pick up anyone between 4th & Townsend. DM me if you want a ride.
jordan: remote today, will pop into the slack kitchen later for the souvenir umbrella hunt :laughing:
elaine: thanks! updating map. if anyone needs a stand-by umbrella, I left 2 in the lobby bin this morning.
mira: @devon thanks — I'll DM. Also filing petty-theft claim for my umbrella (j/k). :joy:
